_metadata.method: Manually extracted from the official RCSD 'Meet the Trustees' page and district news releases. Officer roles, trustee-area numbers, school/area assignments, emails, and term-expiration years are stated verbatim on the source page. Superintendent succession is complete: Dr. Baker retired 2026-06-30 and Dr. Rubalcaba, appointed 2026-01-21, took office 2026-07-01 and is the sitting superintendent named on the Office of the Superintendent page. Baker is retained under superintendent.former for history and is not rendered. Cabinet and director names/titles are taken from the Office of the Superintendent page, which lists each person as a Name-pipe-Title heading. Headshots mirrored from the RCSD Finalsite CDN to R2 (data.rcsd.info/trustees/).
_metadata.notes: termStartYear is DERIVED as termEndYear - 4: California Education Code §35107 sets governing-board terms at four years. termEndYear is authoritative (stated on source page). Spanish role/assignment labels follow RCSD's colloquial register; school proper names are kept in English in both languages. Rubalcaba's executed employment contract is the Jan 21, 2026 board agenda item 12.3 (board packet on R2); Baker's contract predates the scraped packet window and remains pending.
_metadata.refreshProcedure: The sitting superintendent and the cabinet roster are now probed automatically every pipeline run by scripts/verify-live-facts.mjs and asserted by scripts/check-freshness.mjs — a changed superintendent fails the build, a changed cabinet roster prints an advisory. Trustee records are NOT yet probed: re-check the 'Meet the Trustees' page by hand after each November election and the December board reorganization (officer rotation). Run scripts/fetch-leadership-photos.mjs to refresh headshots, then scripts/build-district.mjs. See docs/ANNUAL-REFRESH.md.
